open_points.subject: create after anonymisation or erasure
open_points.text: A01 rule 8 says a create after removal of the former request id "is a new create, answered with the new record it made", and changed R0-36 likewise says "its answer shows the new record it made"; A03 rule 5 and A04 rule 6 still refuse a new project create that names a customer now erased, restricted or ended.
open_points.question: Is the post-erasure request treated as an ordinary new create that may fail current validation, or must it always create and return a record as the changed passages say?
options: Apply all current new-create checks and refuse when one fails.
Always create and return the new record despite a current customer-eligibility failure.
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as an ordinary new create and refuse it when current validation fails.

witness.initial: Customer C is usable; project P was created with request id K naming C and was later archived.
events: The owner anonymises P, removing its request id and customer link.
The owner resubmits the original create carrying K and naming C.
outcomes: A01 rule 8 and changed R0-36 require a new project to be made and returned.
A03 and A04 refuse the create because it newly names a restricted customer, so no project is made.

open_points.subject: re-upload replacing the file bound to an import confirmation
open_points.text: A21 now claims concurrency coverage for "re-uploads replacing a confirmed file"; A16 requires an old confirmation to be refused after another upload "also when the new file has the same bytes", while M11 says a pending confirmation is cleared when used or replaced by the next confirmation shown, and A13 binds import confirmation only to the file digest and inputs.
open_points.question: What state invalidates the pending confirmation when a successful re-upload has the same bytes and therefore the same digest: does upload clear it, or is an upload identity or generation retained and bound to it?
options: Every successful upload clears the pending confirmation.
Each upload has a generation or identity that the confirmation binds to.
The old confirmation remains valid when the replacement has the same digest and inputs.
open_points.default_guess: Clear the pending confirmation on every successful upload.

witness.initial: One owner session holds uploaded file F and a valid import confirmation C bound to F's digest, picks and mapping inputs.
events: The owner successfully uploads the identical bytes of F again in the same session.
Before C expires, the owner submits C with the same picks and mapping inputs.
outcomes: Using only M11's stated facts and A13's digest binding, C still matches and the import is accepted.
Following A16's explicit same-bytes replacement rule, C is refused and a new confirmation step is required.
